scripts.build:cap: powershell -Command "Copy-Item -Recurse -Force index.html, css, js, manifest.webmanifest, sw.js, assets www/" && powershell -Command "$idx='www/index.html'; if (Test-Path -LiteralPath $idx) { $h=[IO.File]::ReadAllText($idx); if ($env:LINSORA_SUPABASE_URL) { $h=$h.Replace('<meta name="linsora:supabase-url" content="">', '<meta name="linsora:supabase-url" content="'+$env:LINSORA_SUPABASE_URL+'">') }; if ($env:LINSORA_SUPABASE_ANON_KEY) { $h=$h.Replace('<meta name="linsora:supabase-anon-key" content="">', '<meta name="linsora:supabase-anon-key" content="'+$env:LINSORA_SUPABASE_ANON_KEY+'">') }; [IO.File]::WriteAllText($idx,$h) }" && npx cap sync android
scripts.build:apk: npm run build:cap && powershell -Command "$env:JAVA_HOME='C:\Users\Urso\.bubblewrap\jdk\jdk-17.0.11+9'; $env:ANDROID_HOME='C:\Users\Urso\.bubblewrap\android_sdk'; Set-Location android; .\gradlew.bat assembleDebug; Copy-Item app\build\outputs\apk\debug\app-debug.apk ..\LINSORA-Financas-v1.0.10.apk -Force; Copy-Item app\build\outputs\apk\debug\app-debug.apk ..\LINSORA-Financas.apk -Force"
